To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

biobanking 4.0 is a customer oriented approach to biobanking that will improve real understanding and perceptions of value across three main stakeholder groups and will improve social, operational and financial sustainability of biopanks.
biobanking 0.0 is the starting point for biobanking 4.0, and biobanking is a process that is not finished yet.

biobanking 0.0 (primary product orientation), biobanking 4.0 (primary service orientation) and biobank 3.0 (primary value orientation) are three stages of biobank development that can be distinguished based on the focus of biobanks on their internal or external stakeholders and on their products or services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a framework for evidence based and customer focused (i.e. stakeholder) biobanking, which is a key element for biobanking 4.0.
the development of a new concept for biobanking, biobanking 30, which is based on the idea to enhance the value for external stakeholders.
the development of biobanking towards biobanking 4.0.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
biobanking 4.0 is the future of the biobank.
biobanking 4.0 will be the stage where all the stakeholders will be happy with the biobanking infrastructure and its services.
biobanking 0.0 is the start-up phase of biobanking, biobanking 10 is the end of the line, but biobanking 30 is the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
biobanking 4.0 is a reality, but we need to work towards it.
biobanking 0.0 is the current situation where the majority of the stakeholders are still unaware of the value of biobanking and the potential impact of biobank research.
biobanking 4.0 will be the result of a successful implementation of biobanking as a service (Biobank 3.0).
The main takeaway from our work is that
biobanking 4.0 is already happening.
biobanking 30 is a new paradigm in biobanking that will help to improve the value and impact of biobanking to the benefit of patients, donors, funders, researchers and the biobank.
biobanking 4.0 will be a reality when biobanking 0.0 (the absence of biobanking) is a reality.
